articles.title: Alaska legislative task force hears overwhelming public support for more investment in schools
articles.summary: Testifiers urged support for more funding to address the state's teacher shortage, special education needs and rising costs of energy for transportation and school maintenance.

articles.title: Solar farm planned for Red Dog Mine would be the largest in Alaska
articles.summary: Teck Alaska, which operates the mine, projects Red Dog will spend $40 to $45 million just on energy this year.

articles.title: Arctic experts worry Russian-backed LNG project a ploy for intel on Alaska’s North Slope
articles.summary: ProPublica reporter Heather Vogell says the surveys near Prudhoe Bay began in 2025 and resumed in 2026 with dozens of contractors on three large research vessels.

articles.title: UAF installs final U.S. piece in nuclear treaty monitoring system
articles.summary: The final infrasound station required to fulfill the U.S. commitment to the global nuclear nonproliferation treaty monitoring system is now in place. Technicians and engineers from the University of Alaska Fairbanks went to Antarctica to make it happen. Certification by the Comprehensive Nuclear Test Ban Treaty Organization, based in Vienna, Austria, came on Oct. 5.
